name: NOTALabs Affiliate Article Kit
author: notalabs

sections.description:
NOTALabs Affiliate Article Kit is a focused block pattern collection for people who write product reviews, head-to-head comparisons, and “best X for Y” roundup posts in WordPress.

Every pattern is built to assemble a finished article section — verdict box, pros list, comparison table, FAQ, call-to-action — not to decorate a marketing landing page. The patterns share a single clean visual language so your posts look consistent across a site, without turning your theme upside down.

This free edition includes five patterns:

  • Quick Verdict Box — lead with the bottom-line verdict and a short summary.
  • Pros List — clean bulleted list of product strengths.
  • 2-Column Comparison Table — side-by-side comparison of two products.
  • FAQ Section — question-and-answer block for the end of a post.
  • Basic CTA — short call-to-action with a button.

How it works

After activation, the patterns appear in the block editor’s Patterns tab under the NOTALabs Affiliate Article Kit category. Click a pattern to insert it. The pattern is just a stack of standard WordPress core blocks (Group, Heading, Paragraph, List, Table, Buttons), so you can edit the text, colours, and layout the same way you edit any other block.

Built for affiliate writers

  • Designed specifically for review, comparison, and roundup post types
  • Uses WordPress core blocks only — no third-party block library dependencies
  • Single small stylesheet, scoped with a naak- prefix to avoid theme conflicts
  • No JavaScript on the front end
  • No external connections, no analytics, no phone-home
  • Deactivate the plugin and your content keeps rendering — only the visual accents are lost

Pro version

A Pro edition with all 24 patterns (Hero Review Intro, Cons, Who-It’s-For, Final CTA, 3-Column Comparison Table, Feature Comparison Table, Winner Summary, Best X for Y Intro, Top Picks, Ranking Block, Pick Summary Card, Quick Comparison, Author / Reviewer, Affiliate Disclosure, and more) is available separately at https://notalabs.lemonsqueezy.com/checkout/buy/10a1394c-e4cc-4422-954f-129e4563c1a8.

The Pro plugin is a clean superset of the free plugin. If both are active, the Pro plugin takes precedence and the free plugin steps aside automatically so patterns are registered exactly once.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin and upload the plugin zip, or extract the zip into /wp-content/plugins/notalabs-affiliate-article-kit/ on your server.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Open any post or page in the block editor.
  4. Click the + inserter and switch to the Patterns tab.
  5. Choose the NOTALabs Affiliate Article Kit category and click any pattern to insert it.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.3 or newer
  • PHP 7.4 or newer
  • A theme that supports the block editor
sections.faq:
Is this a theme or a page builder?

Neither. It is a block pattern plugin. It uses WordPress core blocks under the hood, so it works alongside whatever theme you are already using.

Will it slow down my site?

No. The plugin loads one small CSS file (a few KB) and no JavaScript. There is no database overhead.

What happens to my posts if I deactivate the plugin?

Published posts keep rendering because the patterns are just core blocks. The text, lists, and tables remain intact. You will lose the small naak--prefixed visual accents until the plugin is reactivated.

Can I customise the patterns after inserting them?

Yes. Inserted patterns are just a stack of core blocks. Edit them like any other block content — change the text, colours, buttons, and columns.

Does this plugin make any external connections?

No. The plugin does not call any external server, does not load any third-party scripts, and does not collect any data.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes — see the link in the Description section above. The Pro edition adds 19 more patterns and four sub-categories in the inserter.
